scientific_conclusion: The competitor-margin objective FAILED its primary preregistered prediction: candidate rank-1 on fresh QIM-v4 did not improve (66->64/119), so the hypothesis that SFT6's selection misses reflect a fixable margin deficit is falsified at gamma=2.0, w=0.5, 60 updates. The unexpected finding is that FREE GREEDY improved substantially (57->62/119) while candidate ranking stayed flat — the margin term did not create new selection ability but appears to have tightened decode-time commitment to whatever the model already preferred. Lift was preserved, all floors held, and heldout improved. Per the preregistered fork this is FAILURE for selection, but the greedy gain (+5/119 with zero floor regressions) is a real observed behavioral improvement that must be replicated before any claim.
